A performance-friendly shader pack for **Minecraft Java 1.21.11 – 26.x** (Iris). First release.

### Highlights
- Soft shadows with colored light through stained glass, water caustics and cloud shadows
- Volumetric clouds and light (god rays), procedural sky with sunsets, moon phases, stars, aurora and rainbows
- Water with waves, reflections, refraction, depth color and shore foam
- Integrated PBR: shiny metals, glowing ores/torches/lava, wet surfaces and puddles in rain; optional labPBR support
- TAA, bloom, auto exposure and tonemapping
- Settings menu in English and German with Potato / Low / Medium / High / Ultra profiles

### Installation
1. Install [Iris](https://irisshaders.dev) for your Minecraft version.
2. Download **Yukitus-Shader-v1.0.1.zip** below. Do not unzip it.
3. Put it into `.minecraft/shaderpacks/` and select it under *Options → Video Settings → Shader Packs*.

### Deutsch
Zip unten herunterladen, **nicht entpacken**, in `.minecraft/shaderpacks/` legen und im Spiel unter *Optionen → Grafik → Shader Packs* auswählen. Das Einstellungsmenü gibt es auch auf Deutsch.

### Note
The pack was tested with a headless Iris-pipeline emulator (compile and render tests). If something looks off in game, please open an issue with a screenshot.
